Chapter 6863: Return From Whence You Came

Chapter 6863: Return From Whence You Came

“Boom!” As Li Qiye pierced the ocean of lightning, the bolts wrapped around his arm while wielding the most terrible curses.

They wanted to drill into his arm and made him suffer. Once infiltrated, the curses would never stop until his death.

Of course, Li Qiye would never let the cursed bolts meet their goal. He activated his mortal physique and his arm glowed with an indescribable light. It belonged to him alone because he was the only one with this physique.

The high heaven couldn’t duplicate this light. It didn’t exist during the primordial or the future - a light only an ordinary being could have.

The strands successfully prevented the curses from piercing his flesh.

Meanwhile, Li Qiye’s supreme will began pulling the bolts away like an invisible hand. Of course, the cursed bolts didn’t give up so easily.

Upon being touched by his will, they multiplied into a thousand more and launched a devastating assault. Nevertheless, his will and physique still stopped them, allowing him to focus on imbuing the river of life into the light.

The life infusion turned the light into an eternal chapter, allowing this light to last forever in an indestructible state.

“Go, return from whence you came.” He sent the light into the primordial tree.

Li Qiye opened a gateway to a distant world - a location with old pavilions and a peach tree. He buried the light deep into the ground.

“Crackle!” The tribulations receded once the light was gone from Heavenrealm.

Thunder Emperor couldn’t grasp the situation, unlike Bear Immortal who became speechless.

He just witnessed Li Qiye performing a forbidden rebirth on a dead target. Doing so meant suffering an eternal curse, not to mention the difficulties of the act.

For example, Xian Shen had an incredible dao heart. He tried to obtain life through several methods to no avail.

Although Li Qiye didn’t directly create life, it wasn’t far from it. Moreover, he withstood all the curses and came out unscathed.

The bear knew Li Qiye was an unfathomable monster all along. Alas, he didn’t have an actual gauge of Li Qiye’s power until now. The two feats displayed Li Qiye’s limit.

“This primordial tree...” Thunder, on the other hand, was still in awe at the size of the tree.

“Buzz.” The great tree slowly dispersed along with its worlds, disappearing from sight.

“Let’s go.” Li Qiye smiled and said.

***

The group returned to the core of Golden Lamp and saw the primordial tree with the dao heart’s flame again. They were no longer impressed by this tree after seeing the previous one.

“One world, one tree.” She said softly, seemingly asking Li Qiye a question.

“Cultivators can have a primordial tree too.” Li Qiye pointed at the heart.

“I see.” She said, not at the level to have her own tree yet.

“Go back.” Li Qiye told the two.

“Do I need to prepare anything, Young Noble?” The bear bowed.

“No, just be ready to summon.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Will this work?” The bear asked.

“How many do you think you can call?” Li Qiye asked: “As many as possible, but try not to alarm them.”

“I understand, just one net to get them all.” The bear nodded.

“I hope none will get away.” Li Qiye gazed into the distance.
